# Codinhood

> > A developer resource hub covering JavaScript, React Native, CSS, TypeScript, and AI development tools with practical tutorials, code snippets, and interactive experiments.

Codinhood provides concise technical guides, creative development projects, and experimental tools for modern web and mobile developers. The site features quick-reference 'nano' guides, in-depth tutorials, and unique projects like AI agent testing interfaces.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- React Native
- TypeScript
- CSS
- HTML
- React
- AI Testing
- Dark Patterns
- Array Deduplication
- YellowBox Warnings
- GitHub Markdown
- Three.js
- Debugging
- UI Challenges
- Code Snippets

## AI & Development Tools

- [AI & Development](https://codinhood.com/ai): AI tools, agent testing, and practical development insights
- [Anti-AI UI Test](https://codinhood.com/anti-ai-ui): Interactive test challenging AI agents with hostile UX patterns

## React Native Development

- [Creating a Dynamic Starter Kit for React Native](https://codinhood.com/dynamic-react-native-starters): React Native Infinity CLI for multi-platform project generation
- [How to Disable Yellow Box Warnings In React Native](https://codinhood.com/nano/react-native/disable-yellow-box-warnings): Disable React Native YellowBox warnings completely or per type

## JavaScript Tutorials & Techniques

- [Remove Duplicate Items In Arrays with the Javascript Set Object](https://codinhood.com/nano/js/remove-duplicate-items-arrays-set-object): Remove array duplicates using JavaScript Set object
- [Get Current URL in JavaScript](https://codinhood.com/snippets/js/get-current-url-javascript): JavaScript window.location and URLSearchParams code snippet

## Creative Development Projects

- [How I Built an Oreo Generator with 1.1 Sextillion Combinations](https://codinhood.com/post/the-ultimate-oreo-generator): Building Oreo flavor generator with TypeScript and BigInt combinatorics
- [How to Create a Skybox with Three.js](https://codinhood.com/post/create-skybox-with-threejs): Create 3D skyboxes with Three.js WebGL and Orbit Controls
- [I Can't Believe It's Not CSS](https://codinhood.com/post/i-cant-believe-its-not-css): Satirical CSS alternative using SQL database migrations for styling

## CSS & HTML Quick Guides

- [Simple tree in CSS](https://codinhood.com/nano/css/simple-tree-in-css): Create CSS tree using triangles and rectangles with positioning
- [How to Center Images and Text in Github Markdown and READMEs](https://codinhood.com/nano/git/center-images-text-github-readme): Center elements in GitHub markdown using HTML align attribute
